rules: Official organizer, federation and municipal sources prioritized; secondary press used only where organizer confirmation was not directly located.
Date confirmation does not automatically confirm GPX, elevation or full route.
Do not carry forward 2026 route/GPX metrics into 2027.
Preserve conflicting published start times; do not choose one without clarification.
Audit-only file; no app runtime or live event records changed.

events.name: Belgian Half Marathon Championships (Bashir's Run)
events.detail: World Athletics lists the Belgian national half marathon championships on 7 March 2027 at Wouter Weylandtstadion, Gentbrugge. Organizer Bashir's Run independently confirms 7 March 2027 and half marathon (BK) plus 10K/5K/youth races. No 2027 GPX or ascent data verified.

events.name: Mitja Marató i Quart de Marató de Sitges
events.detail: Sitges official tourism/event page lists 10 January 2027, half marathon start 10:00 and quarter marathon start 09:00. No official detailed 2027 course, elevation or GPX found in this pass.

events.name: La Mitja Marató Internacional de Granollers, Les Franqueses i La Garriga
events.location: Granollers / Les Franqueses / La Garriga, Catalonia, Spain
events.start: Carrer Esteve Terradas / Carrer Francesc Serra
events.detail: Organizer confirms 41st edition on 24 January 2027. Official regulations list start and staged starts from 10:30 to 10:35. Course profile and GPX binary not verified; do not infer elevation.

events.name: Media Maratón Ciudad de Getafe
events.finish: Inside Estadio Juan de la Cierva
events.detail: Official organizer page confirms 31 January 2027 at 10:30, 21.097km, single urban loop, RFEA-homologated, flat course; start beside the stadium and finish inside. A course plan is published, but no GPX binary was downloaded or parsed.

events.name: Hyundai Mitja Marató Barcelona by Brooks
events.detail: Barcelona city date announcement reported by Europa Press confirms 14 February 2027. No 2027 organizer course page or GPX binary verified in this check. Keep 2026 route/elevation separate.

events.name: Grup Oliva Motor Mitja de Cambrils
events.detail: Official organizer site confirms 18th edition on 28 February 2027, start 10:00, with 21K course of two laps and 10K course of one lap. No GPX binary or elevation figure verified.

events.name: Media Maratón de Xàtiva
events.detail: Official regulation confirms 28 February 2027, 10:00 start, 21,097m and a two-lap course. No numeric elevation or GPX binary verified.

events.name: TotalEnergies Media Maratón Ciudad de Málaga
events.detail: Organizer rules confirm 7 March 2027, 08:15, 21.097km, RFEA/World Athletics certified course. Route description starts at Paseo del Parque and lists the port/sea-front roads including Paseo Marítimo Antonio Machado. No GPX binary or ascent data validated.

events.name: EDP Lisbon Marathon Weekend
events.detail: Official Running Portugal page confirms race weekend 9–10 October 2027 and three races: marathon Saturday, half marathon and 8K Sunday. It provides broad course description but no detailed 2027 GPX or elevation metrics.

events.name: Hyundai Porto Half Marathon
events.start: Avenida de Dom Carlos I, Esplanada do Castelo
events.startTime: 08:00 (info page also states 09:00 in a separate passage; discrepancy unresolved)
events.detail: Organizer information page confirms Sunday 19 September 2027 and 21,095m. It states 08:00 in the event summary but elsewhere says 09:00 start; preserve the discrepancy and request organizer clarification. No 2027 GPX or elevation validated.
